citations.description: Ticket comment (GAP 5): 'ran a real rebar review-plan 7a79 --ref HEAD ... provider_provenance: ABSENT'
Ticket comment (GAP 5 IS IMPLEMENTED): 'NOT CLOSING until 1154 is Verified +1' — no follow-up comment with a successful live run showing provider_provenance.tier populated

findings.criterion: [operator-attested] `rebar review-plan` on a real ticket writes a sidecar whose `provider_provenance.tier` matches the configured provider, shown in the ticket comment
findings.detail: The only live-run evidence recorded in the ticket comments shows `provider_provenance: ABSENT` (the GAP 5 comment). The fix was pushed as Gerrit change 1154 / commit b872bc3c89, and the last comment explicitly states 'NOT CLOSING until 1154 is Verified +1' — but no subsequent comment records a successful live run where the sidecar contained a populated `provider_provenance.tier`. The operator-attested criterion requires a concrete attestation naming an observed outcome (the actual `provider_provenance` object from a real sidecar), and that attestation is absent.
findings.remediation: Run `rebar review-plan` on any real ticket with the current code (Gerrit 1154 merged), read the emitted REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, and record the observed `provider_provenance` object (including `tier` and `provider` values) as a ticket comment, naming the ticket id, the run timestamp, and the commit/change id under which it ran.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
